adjudication_6663c28: Adversarial repro (independent, not taken on author's word): subprocess.run(text=True) WITHOUT encoding decodes child stdout via the CALLER's preferred console locale. Simulated cp936/GBK caller -> CJK violation text lost/mangled, probe's --json payload becomes None (root cause of author's 3 unittest errors on a GBK machine; why ZCode's UTF-8-default machine self-tested green). WITH encoding='utf-8',errors='replace' the CJK text is intact and JSON parseable -> locale-independent.

Fix is correct and does NOT hide the defect: it fixes the actual crashing subprocess.run call, semantics-equivalent to judge.run_command's existing bytes+decode('utf-8',errors='replace') console discipline (reviewer read judge.py L90-110 directly).

Repo-wide gap scan (reviewer's own): 5 in-repo subprocess call sites (judge.py:98, controls.py:213/242 = bytes+explicit-decode; check_owned_files.py:103 = encoding+text; m3_probe.py:83 = now encoding+text). The 'text=True without encoding' class had exactly one live instance repo-wide = the one 6663c28 fixed; it is now closed. No second live instance -> no followup repair card required; see advisory F1 for an optional lint guardrail.
